# GitHub Projects board setup

Open the repository's [Projects page](https://github.com/gosafoosei/Mastermind/projects) while signed in with permission to manage projects, then create a project named **Mastermind Simulations Roadmap** and link it to this repository.

Suggested setup:

- **Status:** Backlog, Ready, In progress, In review, Done.
- **Priority:** P0, P1, P2, P3.
- **Area:** Physics, Mathematics, Computing, Biology, Accessibility, Offline/Operations.
- **Views:** Board grouped by Status; Bugs filtered to the `bug` label; Learning improvements filtered to `enhancement`.
- **Intake:** use the repository's Bug report and Feature request forms. Triage new issues, set area and priority, then add accepted work to the board.

The issue forms and this setup guide are ready in the repository. Creating the live board itself requires an authenticated GitHub account with project-management permission.
